Audit.PowerPlan.ReadFailed: Unable to read the active power plan.
Audit.PowerPlan.HighPerf: Active plan: {0}. The CPU isn't throttled by power management.
Audit.PowerPlan.PowerSaver: Active plan: {0}. Power saving significantly limits CPU performance.
Audit.PowerPlan.CustomNote: Custom or OEM plan, not recognized among the standard Windows plans — cannot be classified automatically.
Audit.PowerPlan.Balanced.Default: Active plan: {0}. A balanced plan can throttle the CPU while gaming.
Audit.PowerPlan.Balanced.BestPerf: Active plan: {0}, "Best performance" power mode. The CPU isn't throttled.
Audit.PowerPlan.Balanced.BetterBattery: Active plan: {0}, "Better battery" power mode. Significantly throttles CPU performance.
Audit.GameMode.ValueMissing: Neither AutoGameModeEnabled nor AllowAutoGameMode exist under this key.
Audit.GameMode.Disabled: Windows Game Mode is disabled. It prioritizes resources toward the foreground game.
Audit.MemoryProfile.NoModules: No usable memory module returned by WMI.
Audit.MemoryProfile.NotActive: Memory clocked at {0} MT/s while the modules advertise {1} MT/s — the XMP/EXPO profile doesn't appear to be active.
Audit.MemoryProfile.Active: Memory clocked at {0} MT/s, matching the frequency advertised by the modules ({1} module(s) detected).
Audit.MemoryProfile.MethodNote: Detected by comparing WMI's ConfiguredClockSpeed / Speed. Many motherboards report the same value in both fields: the absence of a gap doesn't prove the profile is active, only that no throttling is visible here. Check the BIOS if in doubt.
Audit.Overlays.CoverageNote: Detection based on a known list — an unlisted overlay can go unnoticed.
Audit.Overlays.Detected: {0} overlay(s) running: {1}. An overlay injects into the game and can cost a few FPS.
Audit.Defender.RequiresAdmin: Unable to read exclusions: administrator rights required.
Audit.Defender.ScopeNote: Generic Windows Defender check — third-party antivirus software isn't covered, and no specific game is targeted yet.
Audit.Defender.ReadException: Defender WMI read failed ({0}) — Defender may be disabled or replaced by a third-party antivirus.
Audit.GpuDriver.NoController: No video controller returned by WMI.
Audit.GpuDriver.Note: Factual information only: no comparison is made with the latest version published by the manufacturer.
Audit.ReadFailed.Note: This lever could not be evaluated: the result above is not a verdict.
GameSession.Subtitle: Optimize your settings for gaming
GameSession.DefaultFeedback: Applies the settings above and restores them automatically on stop.
GameSession.PrecisionCheckbox: Pointer precision enabled for this session
GameSession.Notes.MousePrecision: Disables mouse acceleration — fast movements may feel less responsive, this is normal and reverts when the session stops. Can also be overridden by third-party software (gaming mouse, manufacturer driver, etc.) — not guaranteed for the whole session.
GameSession.Notes.UsbSuspend: Targets the active power plan before the session starts. If the power plan switches to a performance plan, this setting doesn't apply to the newly active plan.
GameSession.Feedback.AllActive: Session started: all 3 settings are active.
GameSession.Feedback.SomeExcluded: Session started: {0} setting(s) active, {1} deliberately excluded.
GameSession.Feedback.SomeFailed: Session started with {0} failure(s) — the other settings remain active.
